title: Souffle de feu
user_message:
je pense que "maintenir" va etre complexe à utiliser, à la place on pourrait faire plutot :

Ben l'effet continue dans sa durée normale tant que le joueur ne bouge pas ou ne cherche pas à attaquer avec ses armes ou utiliser une autre compétence.

Aussi, on peut renommer la compétence en "Souffle de feu"
approval_scope: Explicit requested rename and replacement of manual maintenance by automatic continuation during normal duration while player does not move, attack with weapons or use another skill. This is a redesign request, not acceptance of prior full RP/current-next/numeric/visual card. Revised duration, per-turn costs and detailed conditions are shown in FE02-02 for review.
damage_received_interruption: prior HP-loss interruption omitted under requested continuation rule; no-damage-interruption consequence explicitly shown in revised pending card
unchanged_numeric_anchors: 28 to30 damage, cone90 degrees/range5, three total damage resolutions, eight energy per resolution, cooldown6 retained from pending proposal; revised as per-turn damage/duration/cost for review
additional_proposals_pending_review: duration three turns including initial resolution
received damage does not end effect
precise cancellation on refused versus executed attempts and preview inputs
exact order of automatic pulses and interrupts
scope: FE02 only; other manual channel skills not silently changed
roleplay_text_approval: not accepted by this redesign request
numeric_rules_approval: not accepted by this redesign request
visual_approval: existing catalogue direction only; native preview/timing pending
